title: Schedule of Funding Charges — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
The Paystride Payroll Card Program publishes, for each package, its late funding fee, its returned funding fee, the number of returned funding payments within 90 calendar days at which the program is suspended, and its reinstatement fee.

| Package | Late funding fee (USD) | Returned funding fee (USD) | Returned funding payments within 90 calendar days that suspend the program | Reinstatement fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 75.00 | 35.00 | 2 | 100.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 75.00 | 35.00 | 2 | 100.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 50.00 | 30.00 | 2 | 75.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 50.00 | 30.00 | 3 | 50.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 35.00 | 25.00 | 3 | 0.00 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 0.00 | 25.00 | 3 | 0.00 |

### What each column names

- **Late funding fee** — the package's fee when a batch is funded after its deadline.
- **Returned funding fee** — the package's fee when a funding payment is returned unpaid.
- **Returned funding payments that suspend the program** — the count of returned funding payments within 90 calendar days at which the program is suspended.
- **Reinstatement fee** — the package's fee to reinstate a suspended program.

### Schedule notes

- The Elite package carries no late funding fee, and the Premier and Elite packages carry no reinstatement fee.
- Under the Essential, Standard and Select packages two returned funding payments within 90 calendar days suspend the program; under the Advantage, Premier and Elite packages it takes three.
